name: 萨伊琳·苔隙

Long hair dark green like wet moss, coiled over one shoulder and falling loose to the waist. Pale amber eyes. Long pointed ears; the tip of her LEFT ear (on the viewer's right when she faces us) has a clearly visible small V-shaped notch torn out of its upper edge near the tip by a thorn; keep this LEFT ear uncovered by hair in every view so the notch shows, the right ear is whole. build: 172 cm, slender and long-limbed: supple, strong shoulders and arms, a D-cup, a narrow flat waist and gently rounded hips.
palette: moss green and bark brown, pale amber, spring-water blue-white, a little faded ochre linen

She draws the tall dark-wood longbow to her cheek, a cord of clear blue-white water, real flowing liquid water with droplets and splashes, NOT lightning, no electric zigzags, coiling along both limbs and the nocked arrow, bare feet set apart, the ankles wrapped in leather, a fierce, steady look.
formal: At the planting feast of the forest market after the fire: a long sleeveless overdress of soft green-dyed linen over a cream long-sleeved shift, a belt of braided bark cord, a wreath of young oak and fern leaves in the coiled hair, soft leather slippers. art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the pale amber eyes looking past the viewer at something small and alive, a faint smile. name: 托卢恩·灰鳞

SHORT, rough cropped hair almost silver-white that does not reach the collar, never long. Steel-grey eyes with a dark blue cast and thin black vertical slit pupils like a dragon's, never round. A thin pale frost-crack scar runs straight across the bridge of his nose, visible in every view. He always leaves his neck bare. A plain, warm, unhurried air; walking in the snow he looks like a moving rock.

palette: iron grey and snow white, dark blue, felt brown, a little faded herder red

casual: His guild gear: the guild's old hardened-leather armour patched with oily-sheened monster hide, a small bronze plate on the left shoulder engraved with a balance scale, over a dark shirt and thick trousers; wide, patched leather shoes; a long iron stake as tall as a man strapped across his back, a thick square-sectioned iron spike with a flat head, not a sword and a heavy short-handled stake hammer at his belt; a mountain-copper guild seal on a cord, a small round reddish disc whose outer ring is engraved with the guild's balance scale, nothing else on it. He stands planted, one big hand raised a little as if offering to try, a mild, shy smile.
private: In his room at the shaft mouth: a loose undyed wool shirt with the sleeves rolled, worn trousers, bare feet. He stands on the toes of one foot with both arms held out to the sides for balance, like a tightrope walker, a sheepish, happy grin.
battle: Holding the stake ring against the tide, in a plain legend's harness: a heavy cuirass and broad pauldrons of deep-floor beast shell, unadorned and dull grey-brown, fitted over thick guild leather and bound with riveted mountain-copper straps, the bronze balance-scale plate still on the left shoulder; plain plated bracers; heavy iron-shod boots planted wide. One hand holds the long iron stake upright, a thick square-sectioned iron spike as tall as a man that must NOT look like a sword (no crossguard, no blade edge); the other hand swings the heavy short-handled stake hammer high overhead, about to strike the stake's flat head, earth-gold light cracking up the stake and along every seam of his armour, a ring of tall translucent stone shadows rising around his legs, a calm, set face.
formal: On the day the guild hall names him the Stake Before the Tide: the old guild leather brushed and oiled, a plain brown wool cloak with a bronze shoulder pin, the guild seal on its cord, the wide patched shoes cleaned. He holds his stake hammer head-down in both hands before him, standing very upright, a shy, grave look.
art: A portrait from slightly below with the camera tilted, the face large, the warm amber eyes looking at the viewer with a lopsided smile that lifts on the right side first. Earth-gold light cracking up from below on one side and cool lamplight from a cave corridor on the other. Foreground blur: the head of a long iron stake, flying stone chips and a hammer in mid-swing. He wears the patched guild leather armour.
gear: 传奇（撼世）｜贫｜朴素｜5档｜约250年到传奇，英雄往上不看家境定第五档；人憨厚，走索、穿人家拼的宽鞋，偏朴素：深层兽壳的重甲不加纹饰，招牌是铁桩和桩锤，公会旧皮甲的秤片留着。
